purpose: Screen direct deposition in a fixed ROI, evaluate independent Monte Carlo seeds, and transfer deposited weights to the local mucus model.

parameter_status.baseline_spray: NC04 baseline spray parameters transferred from Shang 2021, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0246007.
parameter_status.search_values: Design grid spanning insertion depth, pitch, yaw, characteristic diameter, cone angle, and initial speed.
parameter_status.roi: Fixed narrow, standard, and wide coordinate envelopes. The standard ROI defines the ranking endpoint.
parameter_status.air_and_wall: Quiescent air, one-way droplet transport, instantaneous release, and irreversible first-hit wall capture.
parameter_status.mucus_speed: Local transport speed of 1 mm/min, with reference to Rigaut 2025, DOI 10.1016/j.ijpharm.2025.125392.
parameter_status.mucus_biology: Transport and biology parameters from config.json, with shared baseline kinetics across four strains.
parameter_status.mucus_mapping: Project standard-ROI hit coordinates along the posterior axis into a local strip with the same wall area as the labelled triangles. The ROI deposition defines the initial source.
parameter_status.replicates: Independent random seeds quantify Monte Carlo variation in stratified, volume-weighted parcel simulations.
